name: pstack-extras
description: Skills that complement pstack. Pinned sources are cursor-team-kit, superpowers, mattpocock/skills, addyosmani/agent-skills, vercel-labs/agent-skills, and supabase/agent-skills. Original skills are build-auto, committed-browser-proof, local-supabase, legacy-critique, prd, merge-reviews, and greenfield. /critique, /prd, /merge-reviews, /spec, and /build call those skills. greenfield runs the path from an old repo to build-auto. poteto-mode remains the entry point.
